svg.title: KuaiFlow Week 3 end-to-end ranking results
svg.desc: Grouped ranking metrics at K 20 and K 50, a fixed-candidate reorder diagram, and per-target NDCG comparison for the Week 3 rankers.
svg.text: Test set · fixed Week 2 top-100 candidates · ranking depth K = 20 and 50
First measured logs → retrieval → multi-task ranking → final list
ranking cannot recover a missed candidate
NDCG@20 · rare-action rows (n=33–84) are high variance
Composite vs DeepFM NDCG@20: +6.6% test, −0.8% validation · equal-weight utility is a transparent baseline, not an optimized policy
Higher ranking metrics are better · coverage is a concentration diagnostic
